en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photographic view over a valley with a scattered village or small city, surrounded by fields and trees, with coniferous forest in the foreground. The landscape is labeled 'Gruss aus Pyrmont' (Greetings from Pyrmont), and appears to be a turn-of-the-century German rural or spa town setting. The reverse side shows the German imperial postal system ('Deutsche Reichspost'), an early 20th-century German postage stamp, a cancellation from 'PYRMONT', and is addressed to Bremen. There is also a stamp from 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'.
